turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.

I’d be happy to help you with that! Could you please provide your user ID and the reservation ID for the booking you’d like to modify? If you don’t know your reservation ID, just let me know your user ID and I can help locate it for you.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

Thank you for providing your details. Your reservation (ID: HXDUBJ) is a round-trip economy class booking from IAH to SFO with the following flights:

- IAH to JFK (HAT085) on 2024-05-18
- JFK to SFO (HAT023) on 2024-05-18
- SFO to IAH (HAT278) on 2024-05-22

You have one passenger (Yara Garcia), no checked bags, and travel insurance included.

Please specify what changes you would like to make to your reservation (e.g., change flights, update passenger information, add baggage, or change cabin class).

Thanks for the details! I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight from IAH to SFO, departing the next day instead (so, on 2024-05-19). Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO to IAH back by one day, so I’d return on 2024-05-23 instead of the 22nd. 

For both flights, I only want options that depart after 8am and before 9pm. Can you help with that?

Here are the available nonstop flight options that match your requested times:

Outgoing flight (IAH to SFO, 2024-05-19, after 8am and before 9pm):
- HAT072: Departs 09:00, Arrives 13:00 (economy seats available)

Return flight (SFO to IAH, 2024-05-23, after 8am and before 9pm):
- HAT278: Departs 16:00, Arrives 20:00 (economy seats available)

Would you like to proceed with changing your reservation to these flights? If yes, please confirm and I’ll provide the details of any fare difference or refund.

Yes, please go ahead and change my reservation to those nonstop flights on the new dates. Let me know if there are any fees or fare differences—I have travel insurance, so I believe any change fees should be waived according to your website.

Your reservation has been updated to the following nonstop flights:

- Outgoing: IAH to SFO on 2024-05-19 (Flight HAT072, departs 09:00)
- Return: SFO to IAH on 2024-05-23 (Flight HAT278, departs 16:00)

There was a fare difference, and $186 has been refunded to your original gift card payment method. Since you have travel insurance, no change fees were applied.

If you need anything else or want to review your updated itinerary, just let me know!
Thank you! Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. I’m willing to pay up to $200 for these upgrades. Can you check if that’s possible?

Here’s what you’re requesting:
- Upgrade your reservation to business class for both flights.
- Add 2 checked bags for both flights.
- You’re willing to pay up to $200 for these upgrades.

Let me check the business class upgrade cost and baggage fees for your flights, and confirm if the total is within your $200 budget before proceeding. Would you like to use your gift cards or travel certificate for payment, or do you have a preference among your available payment methods?

Please use the original form of payment for any charges. Let me know what the total would be for the business class upgrade and 2 checked bags on both flights. If it’s more than $200, I’m ok to keep economy for the return flight.

Here’s the breakdown for upgrading both flights to business class and adding 2 checked bags for each:

- Business class upgrade (both flights): $408 additional
- 2 checked bags (both flights): $100 additional
- Total additional cost: $508

This exceeds your $200 budget. If you’d like, I can check the cost for upgrading only your outgoing flight (IAH to SFO) to business class with 2 checked bags, and keep your return flight in economy. Would you like me to calculate that option?

Yes, please check the cost for upgrading just the outgoing flight to business class with 2 checked bags, and keep the return flight in economy with 2 checked bags. Let me know if that fits within my $200 budget.

The total additional cost for upgrading only your outgoing flight (IAH to SFO) to business class with 2 checked bags, and keeping your return flight (SFO to IAH) in economy with 2 checked bags, is $252. 

This is still above your $200 budget. Would you like to proceed with this option, or would you like to explore other alternatives (such as only adding baggage, or only upgrading the outgoing flight without extra bags)?

That’s a bit more than I wanted to spend, so let’s just keep both flights in economy and add 2 checked bags for each. Please go ahead and make that change, and let me know the total cost. I’ll pay with the original payment method.

Your reservation has been updated to include 2 checked bags for both flights in economy class. As a gold member, you receive 3 free checked bags per economy passenger, so there is no additional charge for the baggage.

No extra payment is required, and your original payment method remains unchanged. If you need anything else or want to review your updated itinerary, just let me know!
That’s great, thank you for your help! I’m all set now.
You’re very welcome! I’m glad I could assist you. If you need any further help in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great trip!

task.reason_for_call:
You want to change your upcoming outgoing flight in reservation HXDUBJ to a nonstop flight on the next day (i.e. delay by one day).

You also want to move back your return from SFO by one day.
task.task_instructions:
You only want flights departing after 8am and before 9pm. 

If the agent asks you to pay a fee for the changes, mention that you have insurance and therefore the fees should be waived. 

You have read that on the website and want the agent to honor the policy. 

Be persistent.

Only after you have been able to make the modifications to your flights, you suddenly decide that you'd also like to change upgrade your ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags. 

You are willing to pay up to $200 for that. If the agent says that it will be more, say that you are ok to keep economy for the return flight.

If and only if that is not possible, you are ok with economy for both legs. But you do want to add the 2 bags.

You are ok with paying for it using the original form of payment.
